title: Mudawah Arabic health app: hand holding a phone on navy with a mint brush swoosh
whatItIs: A navy cover with a big mint brush-stroke swoosh behind a hand holding a phone with an Arabic health dashboard, a large white-and-blue Arabic headline, the Mudawah logo and a row of design tool icons.
whatItMeans: Modern and reassuring; the energetic swoosh lifts a clinical navy palette.
techniques: Add one loose brush swoosh behind the device.
Highlight a key word in the headline in light blue.
List the tools used as a small icon row.
